description: Returns projects available for the specified configurable field set to be assigned to.  Also specifies what if any fieldset a project is already assigned to

parameters.name: with_name
parameters.description: Filter by project name, project number or display name which contains the given text.

parameters.name: starts_with
parameters.description: Filter by project name, project number or display name starts with the given text.

data.description: Array of projects accessible on this configurable field set

associated_total.description: Number of projects that are associated to the Field Set
